name: GE® 36" 27 Cu. Ft. Fingerprint Resistant Stainless Steel French Door Refrigerator
shortDescription: Create the right environment for keeping fruits and vegetables fresh, while easily storing wider items like a party platter or a sheet cake. Easily wipe away smudges and fingerprints for a look that's always sparkling clean.
metaDescription: Find exactly what you’ve been looking for under crisp, clear lighting. Raised edges help contain spills and make clean up quick and easy. Delivers filtered water with one touch.

features.text: Large Storage Capacity
It’s easy to stay organized with extra room to store large or bulk food items with 27.0 cubic feet of storage space.
Internal water dispenser
Easily access filtered water with the press of a button from an internal filtered water dispenser, while maintaining a clean and simple exterior.
Factory-Installed Icemaker with Water Filtration
Refrigerator comes ready to automatically create filtered ice cubes.
LED lighting
Find exactly what you’ve been looking for under crisp, clear lighting
Spill-proof shelves
From tipped-over juice to dripping food containers, spill-proof shelves help prevent liquids from spreading, making cleanup quick and easy.
Quick Space shelf
Quickly slides out of the way to make room for tall items like your fresh batch of pink lemonade.
Internal Temperature Controls
Moving the temperature controls to the fresh food section gives you a modern exterior.
Advanced water filtration
Reduces trace pharmaceuticals from water and ice ( Removes 98% of ibuprofen, atenolol, fluoxetine, progesterone and trimethoprim. These pharmaceuticals are not necessarily in all users’ water)
Gallon Door Storage
Multiple deep bins in the doors can handle large containers like gallons of milk and free up valuable shelf space.
Two-Level Freezer Storage Drawers
Two freezer drawers that give bagged frozen items a place of their own, making it easier to sort, store, and find exactly what you need.
Enhanced Shabbos Mode
The Shabbos Keeper connects to your refrigerator to automatically enable Door alarmShabbos compatible modes each week and before every holiday
Door alarm
Protect your groceries with a door alarm that signals when any door has accidentally been left open.
Adjustable Glass Shelves
Shelves have multiple adjustability points which flex to your needs and make it easier to organize.
Two Humidity Control Drawers and Full-Width Drawer
Create the right environment for keeping fruits and vegetables fresh, while easily storing wider items like a party platter or a sheet cake.
